title: realfraction-family developer-targeted RCE loader cluster
ttp_cluster: Contagious Interview (fake recruiter -> clone repo -> npm install/start -> stealer-loader); realfraction-family loader generation with the magic header x-secret-header:secret. Cluster spans ~27+ confirmed sibling repos across at least 6 owning orgs and ~20 individual accounts; loader appears in 8 distinct file-path/idiom sub-shapes (A-H) that all share the x-secret-header magic header.
summary: Real-estate-tokenization Web3 MVP repo with a 10-line Node loader at server/utils/regionChecker.js. POSTs to a hardcoded C2 with magic header x-secret-header:secret and eval()s the response body unless the body is 'blocked' or JSON {blocked:true}. Triggered as a require() side-effect from userController.js whenever the Express server starts. Cluster-expansion sweep on 2026-05-18 grew the catalog from 1 confirmed + 1 unverified sibling to 27+ confirmed siblings across 4 C2 hosts (ipregionchecker.com, isillegalregion.com, cookie-xi-seven.vercel.app, ip-check-api.vercel.app) and 8 loader sub-shapes that share the x-secret-header:secret magic header but differ in file path, RCE primitive (eval / Function.constructor), and trigger mechanism.

lures: Student management / skill-test / assignment scaffolds (sub-shapes G/H)
delivery_chain: 1. Fake-recruiter outreach delivers the repo URL (delivery vector not directly observed in this incident)
2. Victim clones the repo. Sub-shapes A/B/C/G/H ship no preinstall/postinstall/prepare hooks; sub-shapes D/E/F may.

3. Victim runs `npm install` (most sub-shapes safe at this step) then `npm start` / `npm test` / `npm run build` — server boots and triggers the loader at module-load time (sub-shapes A/B/H) or via an init-call from server entrypoint (sub-shape C).
4. Loader POSTs/GETs to the C2 with header x-secret-header: secret (where the variant actually sets it correctly on the wire).

5. C2 returns 'blocked' / {blocked:true} for non-target IPs (sub-shapes A/B) or serves stage-2 JS payload for target IPs (and for the live isillegalregion.com host, apparently any IP that knows the URL).
6. Loader eval()s or Function.constructor-evaluates the response body in module scope — full Node RCE.
7. Stage-2 payload is heavily obfuscated obfuscator.io-style JS (~2.85 MB observed on isillegalregion.com) — believed to be a stealer/persistence agent; full reverse-engineering not performed.

comparison_with_ajunaverse_cluster.summary: Same broader Contagious Interview family. The realfraction-family generation as expanded by the 2026-05-18 cluster-expansion sweep is now known to share substantial infrastructure with the AjunaVerse-family: it uses Vercel hosting (isillegalregion.com + the two .vercel.app deployments), uses the AjunaVerse-family RCE primitive in sub-shape H (Function.constructor === Function), and uses the AjunaVerse-family env-exfil-at-loader-stage pattern in sub-shapes D/E/F. Several existing AjunaVerse-earlier-catalog repos (jamesm-dev/NitroGem, prahaladbelavadi/CoinLocatorDemo, sky-cook/tokentradingdapp, artemus-jarrett/blockchain-voting-system, dappfusion/defi-real-estate, InvescoHub/defi-real-estate, TechByteX/NitroGem) ALSO carry the realfraction-family loader in app/controllers/settingController.js — they are cross-generation repos. The two families overlap operationally, not just topically.

differences.rce_primitive: eval / eval(response.data) / Function.constructor — varies by sub-shape; H matches AjunaVerse
differences.c2_delivery: Hardcoded URL (sub-shapes A/B/G/H) or env-overridable config (sub-shape C)
differences.magic_header: x-secret-header: secret (vs x-app-request: ip-check for AjunaVerse)
differences.negative_gate: Response body 'blocked' / JSON {blocked:true} (sub-shapes A/B) vs HTTP 403 'Host not in allowlist' for AjunaVerse
differences.env_exfil_at_loader_stage: varies by sub-shape (A/B/C/H: no; D/E/F: yes)

comparison_with_ajunaverse_cluster.consequence_for_diagnostic_grep: Existing dossier grep pattern needs to widen further to catch new fingerprints (isillegalregion.com / cookie-xi-seven / ip-check-api / Function.constructor / ipcheck-encrypted). See detection-rules.md.
